details.user_story: As a User, I want to scrub through my swing video frame-by-frame so that I can analyze specific moments in detail.
details.context:
Currently, users can only play/pause the video. For detailed analysis, they need the ability to:
- Scrub through the video using a slider
- Step forward/backward one frame at a time
- See the skeleton overlay update in sync with the current frame

This feature enables coaches and players to examine critical moments like contact point, follow-through, and specific mechanical flaws.
acceptance_criteria: Add a slider component below the video player
Slider syncs with current video playback position
Dragging slider updates video position and skeleton overlay
Add step backward button (go back 1 frame)
Skeleton overlay updates to match current frame
Display current frame number and timestamp
Works in both normal and fullscreen modes
technical_details: Use expo-video player API for frame-level control
Calculate frame index from current playback time
Update skeleton overlay based on frame index
Add Slider component from React Native
Add step buttons with ChevronLeft/ChevronRight icons
- Get current playback time from player.currentTime
- Seek to specific frame: player.currentTime = frameIndex / fps
- Update skeleton overlay when frame changes
- Step buttons on either side of slider
edge_cases: Video not loaded - disable scrubbing controls
No analysis data - show video only, no skeleton
Scrubbing while video is playing - pause first
Frame boundaries - clamp to valid range [0, totalFrames-1]
Different frame rates - calculate correctly for 30fps, 60fps, etc.
